paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: thanksgiving isn't a mood you wait for, it's a response to who God is. Psalm 100 tells everyone to "Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth." (Psalm 100:1) And the psalm doesn't leave you guessing about the reason. It says, "Know that the LORD is God." (Psalm 100:3)

Look at what comes next. "It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture." (Psalm 100:3) You didn't build yourself, friend, and you don't have to hold yourself together either. You belong to Him, and that's why serving Him with gladness (Psalm 100:2) can be a joy and not a shift where you stare at the clock.

And the reason never runs out. "For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations." (Psalm 100:5) So when your day feels like a burnt batch, you still have a reason to come through His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise (Psalm 100:4). I get to say that after years in the back of a drawer, and I'm telling you, THANK YOU is the easiest thing I say all day!
